BespokeWhyChooseSection.description: Tired of template websites that all look the same? A custom website allows you to create a unique online presence with <highlight>eye-catching</highlight> animations, <highlight>bold</highlight> design choices, and a <highlight>distinct</highlight> brand identity.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.features_ownership_description: Gain <highlight>complete control</highlight> over your digital asset. A bespoke website means you <highlight>own the code</highlight> and have the <highlight>flexibility</highlight> to implement any future vision without limitations.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.features_performance_description: Custom websites are <highlight>lean</highlight> and <highlight>optimized for speed</highlight>, ensuring a <highlight>fast</highlight> and smooth experience for your visitors, which improves <highlight>SEO</highlight> and <highlight>user engagement</highlight>.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.features_scalability_description: Your website <highlight>grows</highlight> with your business. Custom solutions are built to be <highlight>easily expandable</highlight>, adding <highlight>new features</highlight> and functionalities as your needs evolve.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.features_security_description: <highlight>Tailored security measures</highlight> are implemented from the ground up, providing a more <highlight>robust defense</highlight> against <highlight>vulnerabilities</highlight> compared to off-the-shelf platforms.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.features_support_description: Receive <highlight>personalized support</highlight> and <highlight>maintenance</highlight> for your unique website, ensuring it remains up-to-date, secure, and <highlight>performs optimally</highlight>.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.features_uniqueness_description: Stand out from the crowd with a website <highlight>custom-designed</highlight> to reflect your brand's <highlight>unique personality</highlight> and values, unlike generic templates.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_ownership_question: Do I <highlight>own</highlight> the code and the website after paying?
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_ownership_answer: Yes. Once your project is paid for, you <highlight>own</highlight> the code. It is completely yours. You can host it anywhere, modify it freely, or hand it over to another developer with no restrictions or lock-in.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_hosting_question: Is <highlight>hosting</highlight> included, or do I have to arrange it myself?
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_hosting_answer: You can host the site yourself - you own the code, so that is always an option. If you prefer a hands-off experience, we can take care of <highlight>hosting</highlight>, security, updates, and support for you at a slightly higher fee than pure self-hosting.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_updates_question: What if I need <highlight>changes</highlight> or new features after the site is live?
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_updates_answer: We are happy to make updates and improvements after launch for very small fees (to be discussed per request). For regular work you can also arrange a lightweight ongoing agreement with us.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_content_editing_question: Can I <highlight>edit</highlight> the content on my website myself?
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_content_editing_answer: Yes, if you want. We can provide a <cms>content management system (CMS)</cms> so you can update text, images, and certain sections on your own. Please note that because every site is built to your exact specifications, the <highlight>editing</highlight> experience is not as open-ended as all-in-one template platforms like Squarespace. What you trade for that simplicity is a site that is <highlight>fully customizable</highlight> to your precise requirements.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_design_question: Can you create the <highlight>design</highlight> for my website?
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_design_answer: Absolutely. We can deliver a complete custom <highlight>design</highlight>, and we actively encourage you to share reference designs, brand assets, mood boards, or even your own design files. The more direction you give us, the more precisely we can match your vision.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_performance_answer: We generate static pages wherever possible and serve them from modern, high-performance infrastructure located close to your visitors. The result is <highlight>near-instant</highlight> load times, excellent reliability, and strong search engine visibility without any extra effort from you.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_mobile_accessibility_question: Is the site <highlight>mobile-friendly</highlight> and accessible to everyone?
BespokeWhyChooseSection.faq_mobile_accessibility_answer: Mobile support is always included. We follow a <highlight>mobile-first approach</highlight> and ensure the design and interactions scale beautifully from the smallest phones all the way up to ultrawide desktop monitors. We also build accessibility in from the beginning, so the site can be comfortably navigated using screen readers, keyboard controls, and other assistive technologies by people with visual impairments or reduced mobility.
BespokeWhyChooseSection.title: Why a personal website outperforms templates

Glossary.api_description: An Application Programming Interface (API) lets software systems exchange data and trigger actions in a structured, reliable way.
Glossary.cms_description: A Content Management System (CMS) is software that lets you update website content-such as text, images, and certain sections-without editing code.
Glossary.microservice_description: A microservice is a small, focused software service that does one job well and can connect to other services as your system grows.

CommercialHero.title: I build <highlight>tools</highlight> that help your business <highlight>run</highlight>
CommercialHero.description: Websites and web apps for companies - dashboards, customer lists, booking tools, and the like. We can start with something small and grow from there.

CommercialCustomers.title: Keep track of your customers
CommercialCustomers.description: One clear list for accounts, contacts, and status - instead of <highlight>spreadsheets</highlight> scattered all over the place.

CommercialNumbers.title: See what's going on
CommercialNumbers.description: Simple numbers and charts so you can tell how things are doing - without digging through a pile of reports.

CommercialBooking.title: Bookings without the mess
CommercialBooking.description: A calendar your team can actually use - appointments, people, and confirmations in <highlight>one place</highlight>.

CommercialScale.title: Start small. Grow when it makes sense.
CommercialScale.description: You do not need a huge system on day one. We fix the most annoying problem first, then add more when you are ready.
CommercialScale.footnote: You own what we build - and there is always a clear next step if you want one.
CommercialScale.steps_focused_description: A single tool that solves one costly headache - booking, quoting, intake, or reporting. Sometimes that is a small <microservice>service</microservice>.
CommercialScale.steps_connected_description: Connect it to the tools you already use: email, payments, accounting, or an <api>API</api> you already have.
CommercialScale.steps_platforms_description: Customer portals, internal dashboards, and simple CRM-style screens your team opens every day.
CommercialScale.steps_systems_description: Several tools that work together and quietly keep the day-to-day running - documented so someone else can take over later.

CommercialHowWeWork.title: How it usually goes
CommercialHowWeWork.description: No mystery process. We talk, we build, and we hand things over in a way you can keep running.
CommercialHowWeWork.phases_talk_description: We figure out what you need, what you already have, and what “done” looks like before writing a lot of code.
CommercialHowWeWork.phases_talk_item_1: A short call about your goals
CommercialHowWeWork.phases_talk_item_2: A rough sketch of the build
CommercialHowWeWork.phases_talk_item_3: A first version we can aim for
CommercialHowWeWork.phases_build_description: You see working software early. We demo along the way so you can steer before things get fixed in place.
CommercialHowWeWork.phases_handoff_description: Launch is not a goodbye. You get docs, a walkthrough, and the option to keep me around for fixes and improvements.

CommercialTrust.title: What you can count on
CommercialTrust.description: Straight promises - the kind that matter when you put real work into a custom tool.
CommercialTrust.pillars_security_description: Logins, permissions, and safe handling of data are part of the build from the start - not a scramble at the end.
CommercialTrust.pillars_ownership_description: You own the <highlight>code</highlight> and the accounts we set up for you. No lock-in: keep it, move it, or bring someone else in later.
CommercialTrust.pillars_maintainability_description: Clean structure and notes so the next person - you, me, or another developer - can keep working on it without guessing.
CommercialTrust.pillars_support_description: You talk to me, not a ticket void. Need a retainer or help now and then? We keep it simple.

CommercialFaq.title: Common questions
CommercialFaq.description: Plain answers if you are wondering whether this is a fit.
CommercialFaq.faq_start_small_question: Can we start with something small?
CommercialFaq.faq_start_small_answer: Yes. A lot of projects start with one focused tool that proves useful quickly. We keep the edges clean so it can grow later if you want.
CommercialFaq.faq_ownership_answer: You do. Once the work is paid for, the code and setup are yours - no platform that forces you to stay.
CommercialFaq.faq_security_answer: Access control, careful secrets, and sensible defaults are part of the build. I also write down what was put in place so you can check it later.
CommercialFaq.faq_integrations_question: Can you connect to tools we already use?
CommercialFaq.faq_integrations_answer: Usually yes. Accounting, payments, email, CRMs - if they have an <api>API</api>, we can often connect. If not, we look at simple import/export options.
CommercialFaq.faq_timeline_answer: A small first version can land in weeks once we know what to build. Bigger systems ship in steps so you see progress early. We agree on milestones up front.
CommercialFaq.faq_support_answer: You can run it yourself, call me when something comes up, or set up light ongoing help. Either way, you keep the source.
CommercialFaq.faq_growth_question: What if we need more later?
CommercialFaq.faq_growth_answer: That is normal. We design so you can add pieces without throwing away what already works.

FreelanceFaq.title: Hiring into your team
FreelanceFaq.description: Practical answers for leads and engineering managers considering a freelance senior embed.
FreelanceFaq.faq_hours_answer: Engagements are usually <highlight>part-time or full-time</highlight> (roughly 16-40 hours per week). We agree on core overlap hours upfront so your team can plan standups and reviews.
FreelanceFaq.faq_timezone_answer: I'm based in the Netherlands (CET/CEST) with strong overlap across European teams. For other regions we define a daily overlap window - async updates keep momentum when clocks differ.
FreelanceFaq.faq_tools_question: Can you use our <highlight>tools</highlight> and workflows?
FreelanceFaq.faq_tools_answer: Yes. Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab, Notion, Slack, Teams - I adapt to your stack. No forced toolchain changes unless you want process improvements.
FreelanceFaq.faq_ownership_answer: You do. Everything produced under our agreement belongs to your organization. I do not retain IP over work delivered in your repos.
FreelanceFaq.faq_sprint_question: How quickly can you fit a <highlight>sprint</highlight>?
FreelanceFaq.faq_sprint_answer: Most teams slot me in <highlight>within one sprint</highlight> of kickoff. Onboarding is designed to land a merged PR in the first week so you see velocity, not ramp-up slides.
FreelanceFaq.faq_notice_answer: Standard notice is <highlight>two to four weeks</highlight> depending on engagement length. If you need a hard end date for budget cycles, we plan knowledge transfer early.
FreelanceFaq.faq_remote_question: How does <highlight>remote collaboration</highlight> work day to day?
FreelanceFaq.faq_remote_answer: Video standups when you want them, async written updates otherwise, and PRs as the source of truth. I document decisions in your wiki or tickets so the team stays aligned when we're not in the same room.
